body:
Hey there! Writing is eating up your schedule, and AI is finally good enough to help without making you sound like a robot. Here are the tools actually worth your attention this week.

**This Week's Top Picks**

**Notion AI**
Write, edit, and brainstorm without leaving your workspace. Best for: Small teams already using Notion who want to stay organized. Price: Free + $10/mo. [Try Notion AI Free →](https://notion.so/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Jasper**
Purpose-built for marketing teams who need consistent brand voice across campaigns. Best for: Agencies and ecommerce brands pumping out ads and emails daily. Price: $49/mo. [Try Jasper Free →](https://jasper.ai/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Surfer SEO**
Writes *and* optimizes for Google rankings in one tool—actually checks search intent. Best for: Owners who blog but don't have an SEO specialist. Price: $89/mo. [Try Surfer SEO Free →](https://surferseo.com/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Quick Tip**

Stop treating AI as a replacement for your voice—use it as your research assistant instead. Prompt it to outline your ideas first, then you write the actual copy. Your unique perspective is what converts customers; AI just handles the blank-page problem.

---

**P.S.** If you need shorter-form copy (social posts, product descriptions, ad headlines), Copy.ai and Writesonic are solid budget picks at $36/mo and $19/mo respectively. Test them both free before committing.

See you next week!
